title: Ulyana and the Bakery
author: Coral Yarrow
blurb: Felix Villalobos, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
